work.title: Extract ChangeRepository
work.description: Create a component responsible for Change branch operations: materialize branch, inspect candidate, resolve head, refresh against base, determine changed paths, verify baseline relationships, archive branch state.
acceptance: ChangeRepository contains no lifecycle transition policy
Refresh is expressed as a Change operation
Refresh cannot run with an active stage
Refresh invalidation decisions remain in the application layer
A branchless Work remains a normal state
